messages:
sara: Quick triage — need to lock the 'splitwave' canary plan for the new model-routing flags before EOD. Main asks: 1) exact cohort sizes per region, 2) tenant opt-in flow, 3) telemetry + rollback thresholds. @tom @joyce any immediate blockers?

tom: I can own cohort sizes. Proposal: EU-west 5% -> 15% over 48h, NA-west 3% -> 10% over 72h, APAC 2% -> 8% over 72h. Ramp steps: 5/10/15 (EU), 3/6/10 (NA). Keep very conservative for APAC.

joyce: Need concrete SLO triggers. Suggest these automated rollback guards:
- latency: p95 increase >= 20% for 10m window
- error: 5xx rate >= 2x baseline for 5m
- model-quality: token-level perplexity jump > 15% on canary prompts (we'll run eval set shadow)
Also add a trace tag `splitwave-canary-v1` so ops can filter.

alek: Customer ask: one large customer (enterprise-phi) wants to opt into the first wave (NA) as a managed opt-in. They need a way to toggle per-tenant in the console and clear rollback notification to their SE. I put them as candidate-tenant-01 in the shared doc.

sara: OK — two decisions: tenant opt-in allowed but only as separate flag `splitwave.tenantOptIn.<tenant_id>` and must be disabled if any guard trips. We'll use a circuit-warden mode: failover -> pinned model (fallback-v1) + captive rate limit to protect other traffic.

tom: I'll add the flag DSL and API payload. Draft snippet:```json
{
  "flag": "splitwave.routing_v1",
  "variants": ["control","canary"],
  "rules": [{"region":"eu-west","pct":5},{"region":"na-west","pct":3},{"region":"apac","pct":2}],
  "tenantOptIns": ["candidate-tenant-01"],
  "guardPolicy": "circuit_warden"
}
```

joyce: Ops checklist for rollout:
- have canary dashboards (latency, 5xx, perplexity) with +alerting hooks to #eng-oncall
- deploy-bot must auto-snapshot traffic split and start a 1h warmup window before ramp steps
- pre-flight smoke: 200 test requests/region through canary path and validate responses not degraded

deploy-bot: Canary schedule created: start=1729999200, warmup=1h, ramp plan= [step1, step2, step3]. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

sara: Action items (owners):
- tom: add flag DSL + API contract and update canary doc (due EOD)
- joyce: hook up dashboards + alert thresholds, add eval-run on shadow prompts (due tomorrow morning)
- alek: confirm tenant opt-in legal/SE comms and record tenant list (due EOD)
- ops/deploy-bot: ensure warmup snapshot works and can abort via `splitwave.abort`
Let's meet 15:00 to finalize the gating matrix and signoff. :calendar:
